critical_code_review_comments: Referral system implementation is solid - all 4 endpoints working correctly
Referral code format RR-XXXXXX is consistent and unique
Public validate endpoint correctly handles: valid codes, invalid codes, case-insensitivity, whitespace trimming
Max referral limit (5) is enforced during signup and validate
Invalid referral code during signup is handled gracefully (signup still succeeds)
Referral activation logic exists in session creation (lines 2390-2419)
Rate limiting is strict (10/minute for login, 5/minute for signup) - tests account for this

context_for_next_testing_agent: Referral system testing completed (iteration 23).
